question: Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume.

prediction.sql:
WITH seller_stats AS (
  SELECT
    oi.seller_id,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales,
    AVG(oi.price) AS avg_item_price,
    COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS quantity_sold
  FROM order_items oi
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
  HAVING COUNT(oi.order_item_id) > 100
),
review_stats AS (
  SELECT
    oi.seller_id,
    AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN order_reviews r ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
packing_stats AS (
  SELECT
    oi.seller_id,
    AVG(julianday(oi.shipping_limit_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS avg_packing_time
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
category_sales AS (
  SELECT
    t.product_category_name_english,
    SUM(oi.price) AS category_sales
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
  GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english
),
top_category AS (
  SELECT product_category_name_english
  FROM category_sales
  ORDER BY category_sales DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  s.seller_id,
  s.seller_city,
  s.seller_state,
  ss.total_sales,
  ss.avg_item_price,
  rs.avg_review_score,
  ps.avg_packing_time,
  tc.product_category_name_english
FROM seller_stats ss
JOIN sellers s ON ss.seller_id = s.seller_id
LEFT JOIN review_stats rs ON ss.seller_id = rs.seller_id
LEFT JOIN packing_stats ps ON ss.seller_id = ps.seller_id
CROSS JOIN top_category tc
ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC;

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH seller_stats AS (
  SELECT
    oi.seller_id,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales,
    AVG(oi.price) AS avg_price,
    COUNT(*) AS qty
  FROM order_items oi
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
review_stats AS (
  SELECT
    oi.seller_id,
    AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN order_reviews r ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
packing AS (
  SELECT
    oi.seller_id,
    AVG(julianday(oi.shipping_limit_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS avg_packing
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
cat_sales AS (
  SELECT
    t.product_category_name_english,
    SUM(oi.price) AS cat_sales
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
  GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english
),
top_cat AS (
  SELECT product_category_name_english
  FROM cat_sales
  ORDER BY cat_sales DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  s.seller_id,
  ss.total_sales,
  ss.avg_price,
  rs.avg_review,
  pk.avg_packing,
  tc.product_category_name_english
FROM seller_stats ss
JOIN sellers s ON ss.seller_id = s.seller_id
LEFT JOIN review_stats rs ON ss.seller_id = rs.seller_id
LEFT JOIN packing pk ON ss.seller_id = pk.seller_id
CROSS JOIN top_cat tc
ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC
LIMIT 1;

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
WITH seller_stats AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id,
         SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales,
         AVG(oi.price) AS avg_price,
         AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review,
         AVG(julianday(oi.shipping_limit_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS avg_packing
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  LEFT JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
  HAVING COUNT(oi.order_item_id) > 100
),
top_seller AS (
  SELECT * FROM seller_stats ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1
),
cat_sales AS (
  SELECT t.product_category_name_english AS category,
         SUM(oi.price) AS cat_sales
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
  WHERE oi.seller_id = (SELECT seller_id FROM top_seller)
  GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english
)
SELECT ts.seller_id,
       ts.total_sales,
       ts.avg_price,
       ts.avg_review,
       ts.avg_packing,
       (SELECT category FROM cat_sales ORDER BY cat_sales DESC LIMIT 1) AS top_category
FROM top_seller ts;
